title: Reset stock fork clickers to the Yamaha baseline
completeness: Complete for external stock fork rebound/compression baseline reset only. Not a fork rebuild, inspection, rider-specific tune, or ride-readiness certification.

source.review_note: Rendered PDF pages 114-115 reviewed, including diagrams identifying rebound below and compression above, direction arrows and production tolerance TIP. Original-worded procedure below; not a copied manual.

applicability.included: US 2026 YZ450F / YZ450FT stock fork adjuster configuration
excluded: Revalved suspension requiring a tuner baseline

required_tools.name: Adjuster-compatible tool if required by fitted control
required_tools.size: UNKNOWN; adjustment section does not specify a tool size; use a correctly fitting tool without slipping

prerequisites: Confirm exact bike year/model and stock fork configuration.
Repair binding, leakage or damaged adjusters before treating clickers as the cause.
critical_stop_conditions: Adjuster binds or will not reach the reference without force.

steps.title: Support the bike securely
steps.instruction: Put the bike on a stable maintenance stand and confirm it cannot tip while you reach the fork adjusters.
verification: Bike stable; forks are the stock components covered by this procedure.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Record where you are starting
steps.instruction: Write down the current left and right settings before changing either control. Use the same gently seated full-hard reference for each count so you can return to this setup.
verification: Each original left/right rebound and compression count recorded.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Find the rebound reference
steps.instruction: At the bottom of the first fork leg, turn the rebound adjuster clockwise toward harder damping until it reaches its stop gently. Stop at resistance; do not force it.
verification: Correct rebound adjuster identified; full-hard reference reached without force.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Set fork rebound
steps.instruction: Turn the rebound adjuster counterclockwise 9 clicks. Repeat the same reference-and-count process on the other fork leg.
verification: Left and right rebound each 9 clicks out from full hard.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Find the compression reference
steps.instruction: At the top of the first fork leg, turn the compression adjuster clockwise toward harder damping until it reaches its stop gently. Stop at resistance.
verification: Correct compression adjuster identified; full-hard reference reached without force.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Set fork compression
steps.instruction: Turn the compression adjuster counterclockwise 12 clicks. Repeat the same reference-and-count process on the other fork leg.
verification: Left and right compression each 12 clicks out from full hard.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Check both legs match
steps.instruction: Confirm your recorded final counts: rebound 9 out on both legs; compression 12 out on both legs. The manual gives 20 clicks out as the soft end for both circuits, but actual total travel can vary between manufactured adjusters. Do not force an adjuster to produce a nominal click count.
verification: Matching left/right counts logged; no adjuster forced; any abnormal stop or inability to reach baseline recorded.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Save this baseline
steps.instruction: Save these settings against this bike and the date. This completes the factory-baseline reset; selecting the best settings for your weight, pace and track is a separate tuning session.
verification: Baseline saved, separate from rider-specific optimum.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps
